about.title: About the Faculty
about.subtitle: Get to know the Faculty of Computer and Data Science
about.intro_text: The Faculty of Computer and Data Science (FCDS) at Alexandria University is one of Egypt's leading institutions in computing education. Since its establishment, the faculty has been committed to excellence in teaching, research, and community service in computer science, information systems, data science, and related fields.
about.mission_text: To provide high-quality education that equips students with the knowledge and practical skills required to lead in the digital economy, and to advance scientific research that addresses national and global challenges.
about.vision_text: To be a regional and international leader in computer and data science education and research, recognized for innovation, academic excellence, and impactful contributions to society.
about.history_text: The faculty was established to meet the growing demand for specialized professionals in computing. Over the years, it has expanded its programs, laboratories, and research centers, earning recognition and high rankings both locally and internationally.
